statistics_aggregation.query: WITH checked AS (SELECT s.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v2_quote_evidence q WHERE q.evidence_kind='expert_signal' AND q.reference_id=s.id AND q.fixture_id=s.fixture_id AND q.market_id=s.market_id AND q.period=s.period AND q.line=s.line AND q.selection=s.selection AND q.price=s.recommendation_price AND q.source_updated_at=s.quote_time AND q.score_baseline IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.score_baseline AND q.evidence->>'score_basis'=s.score_basis) AS quote_valid,(s.settled_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v2_signal_settlements l JOIN v2_fixture_results r ON r.fixture_id=l.fixture_id AND r.version=l.result_version WHERE l.signal_id=s.id AND l.fixture_id=s.fixture_id AND l.result_version=s.result_version AND l.outcome=s.outcome AND l.unit_net IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.unit_net AND l.effective_stake=s.effective_stake AND l.reason=s.settlement_reason AND r.status IN ('confirmed','void') AND r.version=(SELECT max(x.version) FROM v2_fixture_results x WHERE x.fixture_id=s.fixture_id))) AS settlement_valid FROM v2_expert_signals s WHERE (CASE WHEN s.outcome='pending' THEN s.created_at ELSE COALESCE(s.settled_at,s.created_at) END)>=$1 AND (CASE WHEN s.outcome='pending' THEN s.created_at ELSE COALESCE(s.settled_at,s.created_at) END)<$2 AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v2_expert_messages m WHERE m.id=s.message_id AND m.source_id=$3)) AND ($4::text='all' OR s.phase=$4) AND ($5::text='all' OR s.market_kind=$5) AND ($6::uuid IS NULL OR s.expert_id=$6)), scoped AS (SELECT checked.*,quote_valid AND (outcome='pending' OR settlement_valid) AS statistics_eligible FROM checked) SELECT e.id,e.display_nickname,e.avatar_object_key,e.enabled,COUNT(s.id) AS total_signals,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible) AS eligible_signals,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE NOT s.statistics_eligible) AS excluded_signals,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE NOT s.quote_valid) AS missing_quote_evidence,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.quote_valid AND s.outcome<>'pending' AND NOT s.settlement_valid) AS invalid_settlement_evidence,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='pending') AS pending,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='win') AS win,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='half_win') AS half_win,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='loss') AS loss,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='half_loss') AS half_loss,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='push') AS push,COUNT(s.id) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome='void') AS void,COALESCE(SUM(s.unit_net) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome<>'pending'),0) AS unit_net,COALESCE(SUM(s.effective_stake) FILTER(WHERE s.statistics_eligible AND s.outcome<>'pending'),0) AS effective_stake FROM v2_experts e LEFT JOIN scoped s ON s.expert_id=e.id WHERE e.enabled AND ($6::uuid IS NULL OR e.id=$6) GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY unit_net DESC,total_signals DESC,e.display_nickname,e.id

statistics_source_options.query: WITH checked AS (SELECT s.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v2_quote_evidence q WHERE q.evidence_kind='expert_signal' AND q.reference_id=s.id AND q.fixture_id=s.fixture_id AND q.market_id=s.market_id AND q.period=s.period AND q.line=s.line AND q.selection=s.selection AND q.price=s.recommendation_price AND q.source_updated_at=s.quote_time AND q.score_baseline IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.score_baseline AND q.evidence->>'score_basis'=s.score_basis) AS quote_valid,(s.settled_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v2_signal_settlements l JOIN v2_fixture_results r ON r.fixture_id=l.fixture_id AND r.version=l.result_version WHERE l.signal_id=s.id AND l.fixture_id=s.fixture_id AND l.result_version=s.result_version AND l.outcome=s.outcome AND l.unit_net IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.unit_net AND l.effective_stake=s.effective_stake AND l.reason=s.settlement_reason AND r.status IN ('confirmed','void') AND r.version=(SELECT max(x.version) FROM v2_fixture_results x WHERE x.fixture_id=s.fixture_id))) AS settlement_valid FROM v2_expert_signals s WHERE (CASE WHEN s.outcome='pending' THEN s.created_at ELSE COALESCE(s.settled_at,s.created_at) END)>=$1 AND (CASE WHEN s.outcome='pending' THEN s.created_at ELSE COALESCE(s.settled_at,s.created_at) END)<$2 AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v2_expert_messages m WHERE m.id=s.message_id AND m.source_id=$3)) AND ($4::text='all' OR s.phase=$4) AND ($5::text='all' OR s.market_kind=$5) AND ($6::uuid IS NULL OR s.expert_id=$6)), scoped AS (SELECT checked.*,quote_valid AND (outcome='pending' OR settlement_valid) AS statistics_eligible FROM checked) SELECT DISTINCT x.id,x.display_name FROM v2_expert_sources x JOIN v2_expert_messages m ON m.source_id=x.id JOIN scoped s ON s.message_id=m.id JOIN v2_experts e ON e.id=s.expert_id WHERE x.enabled AND e.enabled ORDER BY x.display_name,x.id
